papers.title_en: MultiLoReFT: Decoupling Shared and Modality-Specific Subspaces in Multimodal Learning via Low-Rank Representation Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Sana Tonekaboni, Viktoria Schuster, Caroline Uhler
papers.evidence: 多模态低秩微调解耦共享与模态特定子空间
papers.tldr: 多模态学习面临配对数据稀缺和表示纠缠的两大挑战。本文提出MultiLoReFT，通过低秩表示微调解耦共享与模态特定子空间。在模拟和真实基准上，该方法不仅实现高效多模态预测，还显式揭示了模态间共享与具体信息的分布。这一框架为可解释多模态学习提供了新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world perception and decision making are inherently multimodal, integrating complementary signals across modalities. However, training multimodal models faces two main obstacles. First, collecting large-scale, well-aligned paired multimodal datasets is often impractical, making end-to-end multimodal training difficult. Second, existing multimodal representations frequently entangle information shared across modalities with modality-specific information, hindering interpretability and control. We introduce MultiLoReFT, an efficient and scalable low-rank representation fine-tuning framework for multimodal learning with pretrained unimodal models. MultiLoReFT extends low-rank adaptation to the multimodal setting and learns interpretable projection subspaces that decouple shared and modality-specific information. Across simulated and real-world benchmarks, it produces representations that support multimodal prediction while explicitly revealing how shared and modality-specific information is distributed across modalities.

papers.title_en: SkyVLaM: Multimodal Large Language Model for UAV Video Understanding in Remote Sensing
papers.authors: Kaiwen Jing, Ruixu Jia, Bingyao Li, Ruizhe Ou, Ming Wu, Chuang Zhang
papers.evidence: 遥感无人机视频多模态大模型
papers.tldr: 无人机视频中的目标小、视觉模糊且视角动态，语言条件分割面临挑战。SkyVLaM通过时域基础感知器从补丁级视频表示构建稀疏令牌，正则化稀疏基础以鼓励互补时序线索，并自适应选择时间连贯的密集段进行高分辨率检查。稀疏和密集令牌由大语言模型联合处理用于查询条件分割。构建的SkyVid数据集包含101个视频、33.6K帧和1.53M像素级实例，实验证明了视觉令牌预算的有效分配和语言条件视频分割的提升。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly improved remote sensing (RS) multimodal understanding. Language-conditioned segmentation is crucial for fine-grained target understanding in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos. However, this task remains challenging due to the prevalence of small, visually ambiguous targets and dynamic aerial perspectives. In this paper, we propose SkyVLaM, a multimodal large language model for UAV video understanding. SkyVLaM constructs sparse tokens directly from patch-level video representations through a temporal basis perceiver, regularizes the sparse basis to encourage complementary temporal cues, and adaptively selects a temporally coherent dense segment for high-resolution inspection. The resulting sparse and dense tokens are jointly processed by a large language model for query-conditioned segmentation. We further build SkyVid, consisting of SkyVid-VGCG and SkyVid-RVOS for video grounded conversation generation and referring video object segmentation, respectively. SkyVid contains 101 videos, 33.6K frames, and 1.53M pixel-level object instances. Experiments show that SkyVLaM provides a more effective allocation of the visual token budget and improves language-conditioned video segmentation in UAV scenarios.
